newsitem.title: USA: Muni bond sales total $2.08 bln for week of Oct 7.
newsitem.headline: Muni bond sales total $2.08 bln for week of Oct 7.

text.p: Scheduled competitive and negotiated municipal bond sales are expected to total $2.08 billion in 74 offerings for the week of Oct 7, according to Reuters Municipal Bond Information Group.
Competitive sales total $581 million in 44 offerings. The largest issue is a $170 million Maryland general obligation issue on Oct 9.
Negotiated sales total $1.5 billion in 30 offerings. The largest issue is a $600 million New York State Urban Development Corp bond offering through PaineWebber Inc.

An additional 10 negotiated deals totaling $292 million are on Reuter's day-to-day calendar, meaning underwriters have said they may price the issues depending on market conditions. -----------------------------------------------------------
